# zone_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up an existing DNS zone, to confirm it is available to the account and to read its settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zone_dns_zone" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

output "zone_is_served" {
  value = data.zone_dns_zone.example.active
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Zone name, for example `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu serves this zone.
- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether the zone is DNSSEC signed.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Whether zone.eu's IPv6 support is enabled for this zone.
- `resource_url` (String) API URL of this zone.
